exact_future_target.reason: Mechanism identification must preserve the target on which the parent TTFT harm was observed.

H_ART.support: Any common prefill SPIR-V SHA256 mismatch between SAFE and Q4FAST diagnostic artifact sets.
H_ART.falsify: All common prefill SPIR-V artifacts match byte-for-byte.

H_DPIPE.support: ratio >=1.10 in W-S and W-C independently in both sessions

H_PRECOND.support: QF/QP >=1.10 AND SF/SP <1.10 in W-S and W-C independently in both sessions

H_STATE_INTERACTION.support: both ratios >=1.10 in W-S and W-C independently in both sessions

H_NULL.support: No H_DPIPE/H_PRECOND/H_STATE_INTERACTION gate passes AND QF/SF <1.10 in W-S and W-C independently in both sessions after H-ART falsification.
H_NULL.meaning: No stable material parent-like TTFT harm under the controlled fresh protocol.

UNRESOLVED_STABLE_TTFT_HARM.classification: QF/SF >=1.10 in every required comparison while none of H_DPIPE/H_PRECOND/H_STATE_INTERACTION are supported
UNRESOLVED_STABLE_TTFT_HARM.meaning: Stable harm reproduced but current finite hypothesis set did not identify its mechanism.

HISTORICAL_HARM_NOT_STABLY_REPRODUCED.classification: QF/SF is mixed across required workload/session comparisons (neither all <1.10 nor all >=1.10) and no registered mechanism has a fully replicated support gate
HISTORICAL_HARM_NOT_STABLY_REPRODUCED.meaning: Historical harm does not reproduce stably enough to justify a mechanism-specific intervention.

triggers: first greedy token differs across matched arms

infrastructure_policy.scope: orchestration/infrastructure only; no hypotheses, arms, thresholds, workload, compute, shader or target mutation

multi_mechanism_rule.intervention_selection: A later intervention may target only one supported mechanism, chosen by a pre-outcome causal sufficiency rule frozen before intervention data. No tournament of interventions.

post_identification.if_H_ART: one artifact-normalization intervention specification may be opened
post_identification.if_H_DPIPE: one decode-pipeline-state isolation intervention specification may be opened
post_identification.if_H_PRECOND: first adjudicate measurement-conditioning vs production-runtime relevance; architecture mutation is not automatically justified
post_identification.if_H_STATE_INTERACTION: one state-isolation intervention specification may be opened only if its targeted state transition is explicit

gain_preservation_requirement_for_any_la.decode: must not lose the previously demonstrated Q4FAST decode mechanism; fresh matched decode ratio must remain >=1.10
gain_preservation_requirement_for_any_la.e2e: fresh matched E2E ratio must remain <=0.90
gain_preservation_requirement_for_any_la.note: These are future intervention confirmatory gates, not identification outcomes. Parent P6 data cannot satisfy them.

non_reclassification_rule: No result in this new program may retroactively change ANL64 P6/P7 terminal classifications.
prohibited: new unregistered mechanism invented to rescue a failed identification
